While you have at least 1 <arc/>Arc Ability equipped:
<arc/>Arc Ability and <arc/>Jolt Kills grant a Stack of Conduction Tines for <pve 10 /> <pvp [4] /> seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

There is a very short cooldown for acquiring Stacks.

Conduction Tines 1|2|3 grant the following:
• 167.5%|335%|502.5% additional Base Grenade, Melee, and Super Regeneration Rate
• 22%|44%|66% decreased Passive <arc/>Stormtrance Super Drain
• Casting Ionic Sentry spawns a <arc/>Storm Grenade on its point of impact
